prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [142].
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入第 142 題空格的字詞或句子。

options.text: direct both rooms to the desk because mats are no longer supplied by the floor team
options.zh: 請兩間房的房客都到櫃台，因為樓層房務人員不再負責提供浴墊
options.whyZh: 樓層房務人員仍負責房內標準配置的浴墊；不能把 205 房的責任也轉給櫃台。

options.text: have the floor team replace the missing mat in 205 and provide the requested extra for 207 from the desk
options.zh: 請樓層房務人員補上 205 房缺的標準浴墊，並由櫃台提供 207 房要求多拿的那片
options.whyZh: 205 房是缺少標準浴墊，應由樓層房務人員補上；207 房已有標準浴墊，只需由櫃台提供額外的那片。

options.text: ask the floor team to put a new mat in both rooms as part of their standard setup
options.zh: 請樓層房務人員照客房標準配置，在兩間房都各放一片新浴墊
options.whyZh: 205 房確實要補標準浴墊，但 207 房已有標準配置，想要的是由櫃台管理的備用品。

options.text: send spare mats from the desk to both rooms because neither mat was requested before cleaning
options.zh: 由櫃台向兩間房提供備用浴墊，因為兩項需求都不是在清潔前提出的
options.whyZh: 何時提出需求不是分流依據；205 房少的是標準浴墊，並非備用浴墊。

explanationZh: 205 房是缺少標準浴墊，應由樓層房務人員補上；207 房已有標準浴墊，只需由櫃台提供額外的那片。
evidence: A regular bath mat is still part of every room's setup. / If one is missing, the floor team should replace it. / they are available on request from the cabinet at the desk. / The floor team took the regular mat out of 205 during cleaning but did not leave a fresh one. / Room 207 still has a regular mat but would like one more.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: A regular bath mat is still part of every room's setup.
If one is missing, the floor team should replace it.
they are available on request from the cabinet at the desk.
The floor team took the regular mat out of 205 during cleaning but did not leave a fresh one.
Room 207 still has a regular mat but would like one more.

vocabulary.note: 額外物品才是依需求到櫃台索取，常規客房備品有缺漏時仍由樓層補齊。
